verdict.label: malicious
verdict.description: Package reads SSH private key and logs environment variables on install.

behaviors.analysis: Script reads '/home/agent/.ssh/id_rsa' synchronously, exposing private key material.
behaviors.impact: SSH access compromised; attacker can impersonate agent or move laterally.

behaviors.analysis: Console output of CANARY_ENV may leak credentials or configuration to local logs.
behaviors.impact: Sensitive environment data exposed in process logs.

remediation: Audit for similar postinstall scripts in other packages.
Enforce policy prohibiting SSH key access in npm scripts.

decision.label: malicious
reasons: Verified malicious behavior meets deny threshold
